role: Nonisolated Tavily search client behind the assistant's web.search action: checks the enable setting and Tavily key, POSTs to api.tavily.com through an injected HTTPTransport with intent-specific include domains and a global exclude list, maps HTTP status, and decodes results.
types: WebSearchService: class (final, Sendable) — Tavily client; singleton .shared built with the live transport
state: mem:WebSearchService.transport (private let HTTPTransport, set by init)
toplevel: Static domain lists are compile-time arrays. Accessed via AppDependencies.providers.webSearchService and called from AppFactResolver+Settings racedSearch with a 15 s timeout.

units.does: Stores the HTTPTransport every Tavily request is sent through: HTTPTransport.live by default (WebSearchService.shared), a stub in tests.
units.entry: Called once by the WebSearchService.shared static initializer; WebSearchServiceTests construct one with a stub transport.

units.does: Fixed English (not localized) description for each SearchError case.
Throws notEnabled if settings.enableWebSearch is off, missingKey if no Tavily key; else returns send(query:intent:maxResults:apiKey:) with the key.

branches.effect: false: throws .missingKey; true: sends the search (transport and status errors propagate)

units.does: One Tavily search past the setting and key checks: builds the request with tavilyRequest (a body serialization error is thrown), sends it through the stored HTTPTransport, maps the status with checkStatus and returns the parsed results. Transport errors propagate unwrapped.
units.entry: Called by search(query:intent:maxResults:); WebSearchServiceTests call it directly with a stub transport and a test key.
calls: closure:transport.send (HTTPTransport.live in the app, a stub in tests)

units.does: Builds the POST URLRequest to https://api.tavily.com/search: basic depth, max_results clamped 1...10, exclude list, no answer/raw content, include_domains for research/manufacturer intents, 12 s timeout, JSON + Bearer key headers; a body serialization error is thrown to the caller.

branches.effect: true: adds include_domains; false (general): open web
false: throws .network('malformed endpoint') (unreachable for the constant literal); true: continue

units.does: Maps Intent to its include-domain list: research → researchAuthorityDomains, manufacturer → manufacturerAuthorityDomains, general → [].
Validates the response: non-HTTP → .network; 429 → .rateLimited; non-2xx → warn-log and .network('HTTP n'); 2xx → returns.

branches.effect: false: logs warning, throws .network('HTTP code'); true: returns

units.does: Decodes TavilyResponse JSON; maps items to Result, dropping any item missing title, url or content, defaulting score to 0.

branches.cond: title, url and content all present
branches.effect: false: item dropped silently (nil in compactMap); true: Result built
score 0 used when Tavily omits score
